description: This file defines the 'Border' class, which models border styles and properties for spreadsheet cells. It includes methods for setting styles, colors, and retrieving shared components, indicating it manages cell border styling within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Border
classes.description: Represents and manages border styles for spreadsheet cells, including style application, color setting, and shared component retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Border instance, optionally as a supervisor or conditional border.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared Border component for the current active cell or sheet, based on parent property.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and returns a style array from the current style components.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style properties from an associative array to the Border object.

methods.name: setBorderStyle
methods.description: Sets the border style; supports boolean, string inputs and updates the style accordingly.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the Color object associated with the border.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the border color using a Color object.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a unique hash code representing the border's style and color.
